description: Keep one wait for room mail running while an interactive Claude session lives: at session start (including the new process Happy starts on each mode switch), when a prompt is submitted, and when a turn ends or fails. asyncRewake hands a message addressed to this host's Claude account to Claude as a system reminder and wakes it even when idle. Without AGENT_CHAT_LISTEN=1, a config, a token or a project room the command exits at once, and a second wait for the same account and room exits at once too.
